headline: Argentine Country Risk Rises and Moves Away From 800-Point Mark Ahead of US Elections
summary: Ahead of the US elections, Argentine country risk increased while Wall Street traded without a clear trend, with the MSCI Merval falling 0.9% and US dollar-denominated bonds dropping 0.2% on average.
why: Argentine sovereign debt spreads and equity indices are sensitive to global risk appetite shifts and emerging market sentiment surrounding major international political events.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising risk spreads reflect increased borrowing costs and declining bond prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Cautious investor positioning ahead of major global political events prompted capital outflows from emerging market sovereign debt and equities.
